title: Reversible Ligand-Receptor Binding
description: Foundational BioNetGen rule-based model of reversible extracellular ligand binding to a monovalent cell-surface receptor with mass-action ODE network generation.
code:
begin model
begin parameters
  L0 120
  R0 200
  kp1 0.0025
  km1 0.08
end parameters

begin compartments
  EC 3 1.0
end compartments

begin molecule types
  L(r)
  R(l)
end molecule types

begin seed species
  L(r) L0
  R(l) R0
end seed species

begin observables
  Molecules FreeLigand L(r)
  Molecules FreeReceptor R(l)
  Molecules BoundComplex L(r!1).R(l!1)
end observables

begin reaction rules
  Bind: L(r) + R(l) <-> L(r!1).R(l!1) kp1, km1
end reaction rules
end model

generate_network({overwrite=>1,max_iter=>5})
simulate({method=>"ode",t_end=>20,n_steps=>200})

title: Enzymatic Phosphorylation-Dephosphorylation Cycle
description: Goldbeter-Koshland covalent modification switch modeled with explicit kinase and phosphatase binding rules and substrate site state transitions (~U to ~P).
code:
begin model
begin parameters
  S0 500
  K0 25
  P0 25
  kf_k 0.01
  kr_k 0.2
  kcat_k 0.8
  kf_p 0.01
  kr_p 0.2
  kcat_p 0.6
end parameters

begin compartments
  Cyt 3 1.0
end compartments

begin molecule types
  S(b,Y~U~P)
  K(s)
  P(s)
end molecule types

begin seed species
  S(b,Y~U) S0
  K(s) K0
  P(s) P0
end seed species

begin observables
  Molecules UnphosS S(Y~U)
  Molecules PhosS S(Y~P)
  Molecules KinaseComplex K(s!1).S(b!1)
  Molecules PhosphataseComplex P(s!1).S(b!1)
end observables

begin reaction rules
  KinaseBind: K(s) + S(b,Y~U) <-> K(s!1).S(b!1,Y~U) kf_k, kr_k
  KinaseCat: K(s!1).S(b!1,Y~U) -> K(s) + S(b,Y~P) kcat_k
  PhosBind: P(s) + S(b,Y~P) <-> P(s!1).S(b!1,Y~P) kf_p, kr_p
  PhosCat: P(s!1).S(b!1,Y~P) -> P(s) + S(b,Y~U) kcat_p
end reaction rules
end model

generate_network({overwrite=>1,max_iter=>8})
simulate({method=>"ode",t_end=>40,n_steps=>200})

title: EGFR Dimerization and Autophosphorylation Signaling
description: Epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR) rule-based model capturing EGF binding, receptor homodimerization, trans-autophosphorylation, and Grb2 adaptor recruitment.
code:
begin model
begin parameters
  EGF0 300
  EGFR0 150
  HER20 150
  Grb20 100
  kp_egf 0.003
  km_egf 0.06
  kp_dim 0.005
  km_dim 0.1
  k_phos 0.5
  k_dephos 0.08
  kp_grb 0.004
  km_grb 0.05
end parameters

begin compartments
  PM 2 1.0
end compartments

begin molecule types
  EGF(r)
  EGFR(l,d,Y~U~P)
  HER2(d,Y~U~P)
  Grb2(sh2)
end molecule types

begin seed species
  EGF(r) EGF0
  EGFR(l,d,Y~U) EGFR0
  HER2(d,Y~U) HER20
  Grb2(sh2) Grb20
end seed species

begin observables
  Molecules BoundEGF EGF(r!1).EGFR(l!1)
  Molecules Heterodimers EGFR(d!1).HER2(d!1)
  Molecules PhosphoEGFR EGFR(Y~P)
  Molecules RecruitedGrb2 EGFR(Y~P!1).Grb2(sh2!1)
end observables

begin reaction rules
  EGFBind: EGF(r) + EGFR(l) <-> EGF(r!1).EGFR(l!1) kp_egf, km_egf
  Heterodimerize: EGF(r!1).EGFR(l!1,d) + HER2(d) <-> EGF(r!1).EGFR(l!1,d!2).HER2(d!2) kp_dim, km_dim
  TransPhos: EGFR(d!1,Y~U).HER2(d!1) -> EGFR(d!1,Y~P).HER2(d!1) k_phos
  Dephos: EGFR(Y~P) -> EGFR(Y~U) k_dephos
  Grb2Bind: EGFR(Y~P) + Grb2(sh2) <-> EGFR(Y~P!1).Grb2(sh2!1) kp_grb, km_grb
end reaction rules
end model

generate_network({overwrite=>1,max_iter=>10})
simulate({method=>"ode",t_end=>30,n_steps=>200})

title: FcεRI Immune Receptor Cross-Linking Network
description: Mast-cell FcεRI early signaling cascade modeling bivalent antigen cross-linking of IgE-FcεRI complexes, Lyn kinase recruitment, and Syk activation.
code:
begin model
begin parameters
  Lig0 200
  RecA0 150
  RecB0 150
  Lyn0 80
  Syk0 120
  kp1 0.002
  km1 0.05
  kp2 0.01
  km2 0.05
  kpL 0.004
  kmL 0.1
  k_phos_b 0.6
  k_phos_g 0.5
  kpS 0.003
  kmS 0.08
  k_dephos 0.05
end parameters

begin compartments
  PM 2 1.0
end compartments

begin molecule types
  Lig(l1,l2)
  RecA(a,b~U~P)
  RecB(a,g~U~P)
  Lyn(u)
  Syk(tsh2)
end molecule types

begin seed species
  Lig(l1,l2) Lig0
  RecA(a,b~U) RecA0
  RecB(a,g~U) RecB0
  Lyn(u) Lyn0
  Syk(tsh2) Syk0
end seed species

begin observables
  Molecules CrosslinkedRec Lig(l1!1,l2!2).RecA(a!1).RecB(a!2)
  Molecules PhosphoBeta RecA(b~P)
  Molecules PhosphoGamma RecB(g~P)
  Molecules BoundSyk RecB(g~P!1).Syk(tsh2!1)
end observables

begin reaction rules
  LigCapture: Lig(l1,l2) + RecA(a) <-> Lig(l1!1,l2).RecA(a!1) kp1, km1
  CrossLink: Lig(l1!1,l2).RecA(a!1) + RecB(a) <-> Lig(l1!1,l2!2).RecA(a!1).RecB(a!2) kp2, km2
  LynBind: RecA(b~U) + Lyn(u) <-> RecA(b~U!1).Lyn(u!1) kpL, kmL
  PhosBeta: Lig(l1!1,l2!2).RecA(a!1,b~U!3).Lyn(u!3).RecB(a!2,g~U) -> Lig(l1!1,l2!2).RecA(a!1,b~P!3).Lyn(u!3).RecB(a!2,g~U) k_phos_b
  PhosGamma: Lig(l1!1,l2!2).RecA(a!1,b~P).RecB(a!2,g~U) -> Lig(l1!1,l2!2).RecA(a!1,b~P).RecB(a!2,g~P) k_phos_g
  SykRecruit: RecB(g~P) + Syk(tsh2) <-> RecB(g~P!1).Syk(tsh2!1) kpS, kmS
  DephosGamma: RecB(g~P) -> RecB(g~U) k_dephos
end reaction rules
end model

generate_network({overwrite=>1,max_iter=>8})
simulate({method=>"ode",t_end=>50,n_steps=>250})

title: Multi-Site Scaffold MAPK Signaling with Dose-Response Data
description: Rule-based scaffold-mediated MAPK signaling assembly (KSR scaffold binding Raf, MEK, and ERK) demonstrating prozone combinatorial inhibition paired with dose-response assay data.
code:
begin model
begin parameters
  Scaf0 100
  Raf0 80
  MEK0 120
  ERK0 150
  kp_raf 0.005
  km_raf 0.05
  kp_mek 0.005
  km_mek 0.05
  kp_erk 0.004
  km_erk 0.06
  k_act_mek 0.7
  k_act_erk 0.6
  k_dephos 0.08
end parameters

begin compartments
  Cyt 3 1.0
end compartments

begin molecule types
  Scaf(r,m,e)
  Raf(s)
  MEK(s,st~U~P)
  ERK(s,st~U~P)
end molecule types

begin seed species
  Scaf(r,m,e) Scaf0
  Raf(s) Raf0
  MEK(s,st~U) MEK0
  ERK(s,st~U) ERK0
end seed species

begin observables
  Molecules ActiveMEK MEK(st~P)
  Molecules ActiveERK ERK(st~P)
  Molecules FullComplex Scaf(r!1,m!2,e!3).Raf(s!1).MEK(s!2).ERK(s!3)
end observables

begin reaction rules
  BindRaf: Scaf(r) + Raf(s) <-> Scaf(r!1).Raf(s!1) kp_raf, km_raf
  BindMEK: Scaf(m) + MEK(s) <-> Scaf(m!1).MEK(s!1) kp_mek, km_mek
  BindERK: Scaf(e) + ERK(s) <-> Scaf(e!1).ERK(s!1) kp_erk, km_erk
  PhosMEK: Scaf(r!1,m!2).Raf(s!1).MEK(s!2,st~U) -> Scaf(r!1,m!2).Raf(s!1).MEK(s!2,st~P) k_act_mek
  PhosERK: Scaf(m!1,e!2).MEK(s!1,st~P).ERK(s!2,st~U) -> Scaf(m!1,e!2).MEK(s!1,st~P).ERK(s!2,st~P) k_act_erk
  DephosMEK: MEK(st~P) -> MEK(st~U) k_dephos
  DephosERK: ERK(st~P) -> ERK(st~U) k_dephos
end reaction rules
end model

generate_network({overwrite=>1,max_iter=>10})
simulate({method=>"ode",t_end=>60,n_steps=>300})
